other_measurements.label: mortality rate (primary endpoint, time not specified)
named: The primary endpoints in this trial were a decrease in mortality, duration of hospitalisation and need for intensive care unit (ICU) admission.

Differences in duration of hospitalisation, number of patients whose condition deteriorated and required ICU admission, length of ICU stay, mortality rate and results of 30-day follow-up after discharge were also evaluated as outcome measures.
result: There was one death ‏in the control group ‏and none in the case group; this difference was insignificant (P = 0.495).
